<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Survey</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/b8a7e12c-ed31-41e0-b9aa-920a17983aab" uiVersion="1" version="3" name="Survey">
					<intro />
					<full_name />
					<phone />
					<pin />
					<age />
					<weight />
					<visit_date />
					<visit_time />
					<seen_at />
					<location />
					<tag_code />
					<colour />
					<crops />
					<crop_count />
					<photo />
					<sign />
					<voice />
					<clip />
					<document />
					<double_age />
					<opening_count />
					<details>
						<nickname />
					</details>
					<household_size />
					<members jr:template="">
						<member_name />
					</members>
					<visits_due />
					<checks jr:template="">
						<check_note />
					</checks>
					<adults />
					<children />
					<rounds ids="" count="" current_index="" vellum:role="Repeat">
						<item id="" index="" jr:template="">
							<round_note />
						</item>
					</rounds>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance src="jr://instance/casedb" id="casedb" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/intro" nodeset="/data/intro" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/full_name" nodeset="/data/full_name" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/phone" nodeset="/data/phone" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/pin" nodeset="/data/pin" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/age" nodeset="/data/age" type="xsd:int" constraint=". >= 0 and . <= 120" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('age-constraintMsg')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/weight" nodeset="/data/weight" type="xsd:double" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visit_date" nodeset="/data/visit_date" type="xsd:date" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visit_time" nodeset="/data/visit_time" type="xsd:time" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seen_at" nodeset="/data/seen_at" type="xsd:dateTime" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/location" nodeset="/data/location" type="geopoint" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/tag_code" nodeset="/data/tag_code" type="barcode" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/colour" nodeset="/data/colour" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/crops" nodeset="/data/crops" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/crop_count" nodeset="/data/crop_count" vellum:calculate="count-selected(#form/crops)" calculate="count-selected(/data/crops)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/photo" nodeset="/data/photo" type="binary" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/sign" nodeset="/data/sign" type="binary" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/voice" nodeset="/data/voice" type="binary" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/clip" nodeset="/data/clip" type="binary" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/document" nodeset="/data/document" type="binary" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/double_age" nodeset="/data/double_age" vellum:calculate="#form/age * 2" calculate="/data/age * 2" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/opening_count" nodeset="/data/opening_count" type="xsd:decimal" calculate="1" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/details" nodeset="/data/details" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/details/nickname" nodeset="/data/details/nickname" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/household_size" nodeset="/data/household_size" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/members" nodeset="/data/members" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/members/member_name" nodeset="/data/members/member_name" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visits_due" nodeset="/data/visits_due" calculate="2" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/checks" nodeset="/data/checks" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/checks/check_note" nodeset="/data/checks/check_note" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/adults" nodeset="/data/adults" type="xsd:int" constraint=". <= count(/data/members/member_name[. != ''])" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('adults-constraintMsg')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/children" nodeset="/data/children" type="xsd:int" constraint=". >= 0" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('children-constraintMsg')" />
			<bind nodeset="/data/rounds/@current_index" vellum:calculate="count(#form/rounds/item)" calculate="count(/data/rounds/item)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/rounds/item" nodeset="/data/rounds/item" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/rounds/item/round_note" nodeset="/data/rounds/item/round_note" type="xsd:string" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" ref="/data/rounds/@ids" value="join(' ', instance('casedb')/casedb/case/@case_id)" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" ref="/data/rounds/@count" value="count-selected(/data/rounds/@ids)" />
			<setvalue event="jr-insert" ref="/data/rounds/item/@index" value="int(/data/rounds/@current_index)" />
			<setvalue event="jr-insert" ref="/data/rounds/item/@id" value="selected-at(/data/rounds/@ids, ../@index)" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="intro-label">
						<value>Answer each question. The visit was on <output value="format-date(date(/data/visit_date), '%e/%n/%y')" vellum:value="format-date(date(#form/visit_date), '%e/%n/%y')" />.</value>
					</text>
					<text id="full_name-label">
						<value>Full name</value>
					</text>
					<text id="full_name-hint">
						<value>First name and family name</value>
					</text>

						<value>Age</value>
					</text>
					<text id="age-constraintMsg">

					</text>
					<text id="weight-label">
						<value>Weight in kilograms</value>
					</text>
					<text id="visit_date-label">
						<value>Visit date</value>
					</text>
					<text id="visit_time-label">
						<value>Visit time</value>
					</text>
					<text id="seen_at-label">
						<value>Seen at</value>

					<text id="location-label">

						<value>Tag code</value>

						<value>Door colour</value>

					<text id="colour-red-label">
